summary: Tested MoltBot Studio workshop-scoped publish flow, Component Presets, card/field editing, and live preview selection. All features working correctly. Backend APIs return data with user_id=workshop:finmodule-sync (workshop scope). History shows status=published.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MoltBot Studio workshop-scoped publish fully tested. All features working: Component Presets (KPI/Card/Table/Button), card/field editing, publish flow with Visual Diff, live preview selection. Backend APIs use workshop:finmodule-sync scope.

workshop_scope_customization_api.details: GET /api/alkabeer-bot/customization?user_id=workshop:finmodule-sync&path=/ returns data with correct workshop scope

component_presets_visible.details: All 4 Preset buttons (Preset KPI, Preset Card, Preset Table, Preset Button) visible in Smart Binding panel

preset_adds_card_one_click.details: Clicking Preset KPI/Card/Table/Button adds a new card with fields in one click. Toast shows 'تمت إضافة Preset'

card_field_editing.details: Card title input and field label/value inputs are editable and changes are tracked

publish_flow_no_changes.details: When no changes exist, clicking Publish shows toast 'لا يوجد تغييرات' (No changes) - correct behavior

live_preview_selection.details: Clicking on blocks in sidebar selects them and shows Property Panel with element ID (page-title-home), title, content, and style options

property_panel_shows_selected_block.details: Right panel shows معرف العنصر (Element ID), العنوان (Title), النص (Content), and alignment toolbar when block is selected

meta_status_shows_published.details: Meta status shows 'نسخة 1 • الحالة: منشور' (Version 1 • Status: Published)

features_verified: Preset adds card with one click - PASSED
Publish flow shows 'No changes' toast when no diff - PASSED
